about_the_game:
Scale and slay giant monstrous creatures as you slowly unveil the truth about your estranged father in this epic cinematic boss climbing narrative action-adventure game

Key Features

  • Climb giant monstrous mythical creatures

  • Unlock the truth about your fragmented memories

  • An explorative adventure of mystery, secrets and ancient wonders

  • A personal, intimate story written by an indie developer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and Windows 10
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 Compatible Video Card (Intel HD Graphics Not Supported)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
